description: A bright operating theatre with white tiled walls and a large metal operating lamp overhead. A young woman in green scrubs, a green cap and white gloves leans over an operating table covered with a green sheet and carefully works on a teddy bear with fine tweezers, a little white stuffing beside it. A young man in scrubs and a face mask stands next to her holding a metal dish. At the end she smiles. A tray of instruments lies on the table.
